2893-3470-6664-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

573-1479-8337.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3220-4279-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-4279-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

983-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
983-1719-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-5621-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Arid Archway's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

4881-6909-7040-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7040-7884.easyPrerequisites: Psychic Paper is attached to Carnage and has "Merfolk" chosen
4881-6909-7040-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-3756-7892.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-6723-6970-7297-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

4687-6287-7704.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Doc Samson.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G} or {U}
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

1912-4893-7426-7648.description:
Activate Assassin Den by paying {U} due to Training Grounds and Biomancer's Familiar, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3446-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3446-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

5670-6291-6830.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6830.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1322-1563-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-1563-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2639-2908-3254-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-2908-3254-4050.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Dream Stalker and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Dream Stalker and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-2908-3254-4050.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

2178-2438-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-2438-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3693-4120-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
3693-4120-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Walking Ballista, but instead putting 100 +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista 100 times by removing 100 +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 100 damage divided among any number of targets.
3693-4120-6758.notes: You can forego step 2 if you just want the counters. Alternatively, you can target creatures you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them.

856-3967-4231-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1339-4871-6460.manaNeeded: {2} if you don't control a creature token or {1} otherwise
1339-4871-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a creature token, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
If you control a Treasure, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3129-5435-5742-5743.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1817-2099-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-2099-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-2099-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2104-2493-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2104-2493-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
2104-2493-5626.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Archaeomancer, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4231-5365-5455.notablePrerequisites: Lonis has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
4231-5365-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis's first ability triggers for each counter placed on it, creating that many Clue tokens, Food tokens and Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2923-3967.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat each combat phase.

1887-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
1887-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1283-1496-2034-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1496-2034-4078-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

97-2034-2308-3000.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-2034-2308-3000.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4365-4659.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

618-2103-4125.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
